SELECT substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which New York cities have the most public schools?
SELECT lcity, count(*) AS schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE st = 'NY' AND school_year = '2023-2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. exports went by air in 2019?

SELECT round(100.0 * max(try_cast(air_val_yr AS double)) / max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2019' AND month = '12' AND cty_name = 'TOTAL FOR ALL COUNTRIES'
What did the Department of Health and Human Services spend the most on in contracts in fiscal 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND upper(awarding_agency_name) = 'DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES' AND product_or_service_code_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many kindergarteners attended New York public schools in 2024-25?

SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS kindergarteners FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' AND st = 'NY' AND grade = 'Kindergarten'
Which Florida cities recorded the most fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Florida' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many kidney specialists (nephrologists) bill Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE pri_spec = 'NEPHROLOGY'
Which health and welfare rates appear most often in service contract wage determinations?
SELECT health_welfare, count(*) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do more inventors on U.S. applications come from Japan or from Germany?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code IN ('JP', 'DE') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which industries win the most sub-contract dollars?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE subaward_type = 'sub-contract' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the longest patent term adjustment the USPTO has granted?
SELECT max(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double)) AS most_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which New York counties have the largest foreign-born share of residents?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_foreign_born FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US36%' AND a.table_id = 'b05012' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many GAO reports were published in 1999?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND date LIKE '1999%'
Which laws account for the most Judgment Fund payments?

SELECT principal_citation_desc, sum(try_cast(confirmed_payment_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_treasury.jfics_congress_report WHERE principal_citation_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many active participants did large plans report for plan year 2000?
SELECT sum(try_cast(tot_active_partcp_cnt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE substr(form_plan_year_begin_date, 1, 4) = '2000'
Which California cities appear most often as inventor locations on granted patents?
SELECT raw_city, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country = 'US' AND raw_state = 'CA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rules did the EPA list in the spring 2024 regulatory agenda?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rin) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE publication_id = '202404' AND acronym LIKE '%EPA%'
Which counties are the smallest by land area?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
How many collective membership marks, like those of clubs and unions, are on file?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(coll_memb_mark_in AS varchar) = '1'
Which counties have the largest Hispanic citizen voting-age population?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE lntitle = 'Hispanic or Latino' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many petroleum terminals can receive crude oil by ship?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_petroleum_terminals WHERE marine_in = 'YES' AND crude_oil = 'YES'
Which ERCOT buses carry the highest average day-ahead prices in the bus price records?
Ercot Lmp By Bus Dam Cdr Damhrlmpnp
SELECT busname, avg(try_cast(lmp AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.ercot_lmp_by_bus_dam_cdr_damhrlmpnp WHERE busname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility-scale wind turbines stand in New York State?
SELECT count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'NY'
Which states have the most units in subsidized housing projects?
SELECT substr(states, 4) AS state, sum(try_cast(total_units AS double)) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE try_cast(total_units AS double) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospital cost reports from 1995 are in the library?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '1995'
Which states have retired the most generators?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled
SELECT state, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS retired FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'RE' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many insurance complaints did Texas receive each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(received_date, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints WHERE substr(received_date, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states have the largest share of adults with a bachelor's degree or higher?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E022' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END) + max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E023' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END) + max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E024' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END) + max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E025' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_bachelors_plus FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b15003' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of medical device reports involve an injury rather than a malfunction?
SELECT event_type, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which tax-exempt organisations hold the most assets?
SELECT name, state, try_cast(asset_amt AS double) AS assets FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of audited federal awards are tested as major programs?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_major AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards
Which parent companies own the most toxic-release reporting facilities?
SELECT _17_standard_parent_co_name, count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _17_standard_parent_co_name <> 'NA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many independents serve in state legislatures across the country?
SELECT count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE party = 'I'
Which states had the highest unemployment rates in December 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many papers are indexed under Alzheimer Disease?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Alzheimer Disease'
Which parent companies won the most federal contract dollars in fiscal 2024?

SELECT recipient_parent_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND recipient_parent_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were most people killed in 2022 road crashes men or women?

SELECT sexname, count(*) AS killed, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which large cities have the highest poverty rates?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B17001_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_poverty FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '1600000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b17001' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
